venues.name: Close Company Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Wednesday 9/23 (MOD MKZ/JK; 79/67).** Net $1,613 vs target $1,303 (+23.8%). Food $196. Comps $72.95. 39 guests at $41.36 check average. Last Wednesday before Trivia Wednesday launches. MKZ opened; not a crazy crowd to start but a good glow, and lots of regulars in the house. Team promoted National Negroni Week and the cause behind it — shot du jour is Campari. One group stayed at the bar over five hours, which the MOD called a sign of the community being cultivated. Kitchen quiet; note to keep communication open. 86 Gin Gin. No incidents. Favorite moment: regular Joe staying the entire night chatting. Entered by Mya.

venues.name: Close Company Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Wednesday 9/23 (MOD & Chef KK/JMS; nice temp, cloudy).** Net $2,006 vs target $1,441 (+39.2%). Food $234. Comps $74.50 / 3.7%, higher on book club and a bunch of industry folks. 91 guests at $22 check average. Book club brought in a large crowd — mostly return guests with some first timers; at least one guest was struck by Edy's hospitality and passed that on to Kira. Trivia drew more traffic, and trivia DJ Caroline stayed an extra hour to run an impromptu round for the book club. Steady straight through last call. Voids ran higher due to book club entry error; end numbers correctly reflect. Kitchen smooth with good sales. Favorite moment: meeting bartenders from 2/10 Jack. Entered by BT.

venues.name: D&C Denver

DC/AM $1,105.13, D&C PM $8,795.61, Garden/6A $2,348.63. Food $2,434.35. Comps $470.71. 243 guests (Tock) at $50.41 check average. Event fields were submitted as NA, so no event split is recorded for the night. D&C was full all night; The Garden closed around 8pm after rain killed foot traffic. Jordan ran the garden solo, got time with some great guests and closed up early. Breaks made up; no injuries or incidents. Favorite moment: heart to hearts. Entered by MJH.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.weather: Nice and warm, then a tad chilly
venues.narrative: **LA — Wednesday 9/23 (MOD & Chef Julian, Josh and Saleh; nice and warm then a tad chilly).** Net $4,387 vs target $5,176 (-15.2%). All volume through the Marquee ($4,387 total / $816 food); standing room zero. Comps $154.72. 120 guests at $36.56 check average. Started at a decent speed — Mia, fresh out of retirement, handled the floor like a veteran. A few large parties, a handful of birthdays, first timers, and guests who had heard about the bar from another state. Steady pace for a Wednesday with the whole room packed for a stretch; died out around 11–12 with one couple riding it out to close, plus a few investors in with family. Kitchen was a one-man band for the second half. Low Aperol, low pineapple juice. Favorite moment: a whole new server team killing it. Entered by Julian Catano.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Wednesday 9/23 (MOD Marcus; cooler evening).** Total net sales including events $3,267.74 vs target $3,506 (-6.8%). Marquee bar sales $3,601.33, garden $0, food $545.80. Comps $108.72 (member/investor $41, manager service recovery $45, industry $2, gift $19.80). 85 guests — 63 walk-in, 22 reservation — at $38.44 net per guest. Weather finally cooling in DC; steady start with the biggest pops around 6:30 and 7, but a surprisingly large number of no-shows (which were charged). The team was excited to break out new Toast gift cards but hit an issue and couldn't use them, hence the service-recovery comps. Alex was on lighter duties to let his hand heal and stepped into barback and expo; Jesse held service, Chaz paced the room prioritizing tables over bar seats, Devan covered easily. Good kitchen night — will order a better oyster shucking knife. Maintenance: curtains, hoshi splash curtain needs reattaching. Favorite moment: out-of-town regular Jared stopping in. Entered by Marcus.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Wednesday 9/23 (AM Franck & Lex; PM James & Marcus; getting cool, sub 90 and overcast).** Total net sales $4,397 vs target $4,387 (+0.2%). Municipal Bar morning $1,861, evening $2,536, Sun Club $80, Hot Eye closed. Food $1,469. Comps $52. 99 guests (21 morning + 78 evening, OpenTable) at $44.41 check average. Decent morning with three tours. A few lively groups at three o'clock, at least one a tour group; after they cleared the room stayed still and quiet most of the night. A few early-dinner groups, plus a local business that came in for happy hour cocktails and to use the wifi while theirs was out. Cuts made, with Eva and Jonathan closing the bar and Carla, assisted by Estella, closing the floor. Sun Club very slow despite nicer weather. Kitchen slow — got ahead on cleaning, no 86s or lows. Favorite moment: thanks from exasperated travelers relieved by the calm atmosphere. Entered by James.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Wednesday 9/23 (MOD Julian Abel; weather turned, likely fewer walk-ins).** Net $10,500 vs target $7,000 (+50.0%). Food $1,868. Comps reported as approximately $120 in shift drinks plus approximately $350 in SND/DNL — recorded here as ~$470, an approximation from the manager's own stated figures rather than an exact total. 234 guests at $44.91 check average. Strong out of the gates on neighborhood traffic; got a little clunky around 7:30–8:00 when door velocity peaked. Kitchen had some long ticket times, with a couple of DNLs on tartare because the bread ran long — MOD wants to workshop a solve. Maintenance: swing door freezer behind 1000 is on the fritz, service request to be filed with model/serial in hand. Favorite moment: the solo guest who sniped a departing pair's olives and buttered oyster crackers within thirty seconds, finished them, then ordered more olives. NOTE: the Typeform date field was typed as 2026-09-24, but the form reports Day of the Week = Wednesday and posted 12:43am PT on 9/24 — this is the Wednesday 9/23 service night, matched by post time per the mis-typed-date convention. Entered by Julian Abel.
